title: Minimum Length of String After Deleting Similar Ends
goal: Minimize remaining string length by repeatedly deleting matching-character prefix and suffix runs.
strategy: When the end characters match, remove their complete runs from both ends. Stop when the ends disagree or fewer than two characters remain.
